title: Trading 212 Portfolio Summary
description: Account-level summary including cash, invested value, and total value.

cash.description: Available cash balance in minor units.

invested_value.description: Total invested value in minor units.

total_value.description: Total account value in minor units.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code of the account.

cash_pct.description: Computed cash as a percentage of total portfolio value, derived by the sync job.

dividend_yield_pct.description: Computed portfolio-level dividend yield percentage, derived by the sync job from positions and instrument metadata.

monthly_return_pct.description: Computed month-on-month portfolio return percentage, derived by the sync job from consecutive snapshots.

max_drawdown_pct.description: Computed peak-to-trough drawdown percentage, derived by the sync job from the portfolio value history.

isa_allowance_used_pct.description: Percentage of the annual ISA allowance that has been used, if available from the connected account.
